description: This file defines an abstract base class 'VisualComparisonTestBase' used for creating, manipulating, and comparing PDF documents and related formats in test scenarios. It includes methods for generating PDFs from MigraDoc documents or DDL strings, handling external references, copying and annotating PDF pages, and comparing PDFs side-by-side or by appending pages. It is part of testing infrastructure for PDF rendering and document generation.

classes.name: VisualComparisonTestBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods for creating, handling, and comparing PDF documents in testing scenarios, including rendering from MigraDoc, handling references, and side-by-side comparisons.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromDocument
methods.description: Generates a PDF from a MigraDoc Document object, saves it to a specified file, optionally invokes a callback for document initialization, and optionally outputs auxiliary formats in debug mode.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromMdddlFile
methods.description: Reads a MigraDoc Document from a .mdddl file and creates a PDF from it, appending platform-specific info to document metadata.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromDdlString
methods.description: Creates a MigraDoc Document from a DDL string and then generates a PDF from it.

methods.name: DdlReaderDocumentFromFile
methods.description: Reads a MigraDoc Document from a file stream with ANSI encoding, using a DdlReader.

methods.name: FindReferenceFile
methods.description: Locates a reference PDF file based on a source directory and test name.

methods.name: CreateOrOpenResultFile
methods.description: Opens an existing PDF result file for modification or creates a new one with preset metadata.

methods.name: CopyPdfPage
methods.description: Copies and draws a specified page from a source XPdfForm into an XGraphics context at a given rectangle.

methods.name: AppendToResultPdf
methods.description: Appends PDF pages and optionally side-by-side comparisons with reference PDFs; creates result files for test verification.
